title: Online Tutor (Part Time) - URGENT HIRING
description:
Want to earn ₹20,000–₹30,000 per month as a freelancer? If you have teaching experience or are looking to start a career in teaching and are confident in your communication skills, this opportunity is for you.

About Company:

PlanetSpark is on a mission to build the next generation of confident speakers and creative writers. We are a global company impacting over 13 countries through live 1:1 personalized classes on Public Speaking and Creative Writing through handpicked top 1% of teachers. Our kids participate in gripping debates, create viral YouTube videos, start their own podcast channels, perform stand-up comedy, write nail-biting mystery stories, and become confident and fearless speakers. PlanetSpark is on its journey to becoming the global leader in the large and untapped communication skills segment. We are Series B funded by some top VCs and are on a 30% month-on-month growth curve. We have our footprint in India, the Middle East, North America, and Australia. Join a passionate team of over 500 young and energetic members and 400+ expert and handpicked teachers on this roller coaster ride to build the most loved brand for kids who will move the world! For more updates, please subscribe to our Instagram handle:

https://www.instagram.com/planetspark/

Roles and Responsibilities:

1. Conduct demo classes as per the PlanetSpark content and methodology

2. Ensure amazing demo experience for the child and parent

3. Conduct regular classes (post enrolment) using in-house curriculum

4. Ensure timely feedback to the child

5. Adhere to the schedule for the demo as well as regular classes

What are the behavioral attributes that we are looking for?

1. Excellent Teaching skills

2. Excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills both written and verbal

3. Ability to build strong relationships with the child/ learner and make the class fun-based learning.

4. Tech savvy

Eligibility Criteria:

1. Excellent Verbal and written communication

2. Willing to work 6 days a week (should be available on Saturdays & Sundays)

3. Willing to invest 3-4 Teaching hours every day

4. At least 1 year of English Teaching experience

5. Should have good Wi-Fi and a Laptop with Webcam

Benefits:

1. Flexible working hours

2. Work from home

3. Exposure to teaching international students

Shifts you can opt for:

- 3pm to 10 pm IST (India kids)

-6pm to 11 pm IST (India kids)

-6pm to 11 pm IST(Europe/UAE kids)

-4 am to 8 am IST(US/Canada Kids)

Join us at @Planetspark, if you are passionate about teaching and shaping young minds.

Drive your teaching career to new heights.

title: Sales Recruiter - Night Shift - US Process
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing company focused on connecting businesses with the right talent across a range of industries. For over a decade, the organization has maintained strong customer retention by delivering reliable, high\-quality hiring solutions worldwide. The team consists of highly trained professionals who use advanced tools and technology to bridge the gap between employers and candidates. V Engineering LLC promotes a strong work culture and ethical practices, aiming to consistently place the right talent with the right clients. Prospective team members can expect a professional environment that values performance, integrity, and long\-term relationships.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sales Recruiter – Night Shift – US Process is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Rajarhat. The role involves managing the end\-to\-end recruitment process for sales positions supporting US\-based clients, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating offers. The recruiter will work closely with hiring managers and account management teams to understand role requirements, build talent pipelines, and ensure timely fulfillment of open positions. Daily responsibilities include using job portals and networking platforms, maintaining candidate databases, conducting follow\-ups, and providing a positive experience for all applicants. The role requires working during night shift hours aligned with US time zones and meeting defined hiring targets and quality standards.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Sales Recruitment and Hiring for US\-based roles.
* Candidates should possess skills in Full\-life Cycle Recruiting, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer coordination.
* Candidates should possess skills in Account Management, client coordination, and stakeholder communication.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to engage candidates professionally.
* Relevant experience in staffing or recruitment for international (especially US) processes is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work night shifts in an on\-site environment in Rajarhat and manage multiple open positions simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency with recruitment tools and applicant tracking systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline or equivalent professional experience in recruitment or HR is preferred.

title: Senior HR Recruiter
description:
We’re Hiring:
 **Senior HR Recruiter / HR Manager** 




 📍 Location: Barasat
 



 🎓 Experience: 5–8 Years (Senior\-Level HR \& Recruitment)
 



 🎓 Qualification: Master’s Degree (HR / Management / Related Field)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and strategic HR professional who can independently handle end\-to\-end recruitment for non\-teaching staff and also contribute to designing, developing, and implementing HR policies. The role requires a strong understanding of institutional hiring, stakeholder management, and HR best practices.
 



 This position demands a proactive leader who can manage recruitment operations efficiently while also supporting HR policy frameworks and organizational development initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for non\-teaching roles (administrative, technical, operational, and support staff)
 



 • Develop and execute effective hiring strategies aligned with institutional needs
 



 • Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, negotiation, and onboarding
 



 • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future requirements
 



 • Partner with departments for manpower planning and workforce requirements
 



 • Assist in designing, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures
 



 • Maintain recruitment MIS, dashboards, and hiring reports
 



 • Ensure timely closure of positions with quality hiring outcomes
 



 • Support HR compliance and process improvement initiatives
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 • Master’s degree in HR, Management, or related discipline
 



 • 5–10 years of proven experience in recruitment and HR management
 



 • Strong exposure to non\-teaching / institutional recruitment preferred
 



 • Experience in HR policy formulation and implementation is essential
 



 • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills
 



 • Strong command over sourcing tools, LinkedIn, and job portals
 



 • Ability to handle multiple priorities and work under deadlines
 



 • Self\-driven, detail\-oriented, and result\-focused approach
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 • Opportunity to work in a reputed academic institution
 



 • Exposure to strategic HR policy development and implementation
 



 • Work closely with leadership on key HR initiatives
 



 • Growth\-oriented and impact\-driven work environment

title: Career Process Association - Night Shift -US Process
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing organization focused on connecting businesses with the right talent across diverse industries. With more than a decade of experience, the company has built a strong global client and candidate base and maintains a high customer retention rate. Its team of trained professionals uses advanced tools and methods to bridge gaps between employers and job seekers. V Engineering LLC emphasizes a values\-driven work culture and strong ethics, striving to deliver long\-term, successful placements.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Career Process Associate – Night Shift – US Process will work full time on\-site at the Rajarhat office. This role involves supporting candidates through the career process, including understanding their profiles, discussing career paths, and guiding them through application, interview, and onboarding stages. The associate will handle inbound and outbound communication with candidates and clients in the US, provide timely information, and ensure a professional and positive experience. The role also requires adherence to company policies, process guidelines, and performance targets.

* Candidates should possess strong Career Counseling and Career Development skills to guide individuals through role selection and growth opportunities.

* Basic computer proficiency, including use of CRM or applicant tracking systems, email, and office productivity tools.
* Prior experience in staffing, BPO, recruitment, or counseling is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: bachelor’s degree or equivalent; relevant certifications in counseling or HR are beneficial.
